His hand found the arm of his chair and he leaned back. A half inch, maybe less, but enough to feel the distance open between himself and the detective's question. This was the pivot, the moment the conversation stopped being collegial and started being an interrogation. Adrian recognized it, because he'd studied the architecture of persuasion systems for twenty years, and this was one. The friendly approach, the shared joke, the sudden blade. Daniel Yoon took one of my undergraduate sections, Adrian said carefully, two or three years ago. Bright kid, nothing remarkable. I have 300 students a year. Sad to see where his mind took him. He let the sentence sit, then added, Detective, my work is published and publicly available. I'm cited in undergraduate textbooks. But Alpidine didn't map the specific vulnerabilities in Novimind's behavioral prediction architecture. You did. That landed. Adrian kept his face neutral, but Morrow's eyes were sharp. Not aggressive, just attentive, watching the board after moving a piece. I mapped theoretical vulnerabilities, Adrian said carefully, in a generalized class of systems. My work doesn't mention Novimind by name. It doesn't need to. Novimind is the market leader. If you describe the vulnerabilities of the tallest building in the city, you don't have to print its address. Adrian studied the detective. There was something about Morrow, a directness, a lack of pretense. It was disorienting in its simplicity. Most people who entered Adrian's office wanted something and tried to hide it. Morrow wanted something and was putting it on the table like a man dealing cards face up. What do you need, detective? If Maro leaned forward slightly, the espionage case is more complicated than what's been reported. The systems the suspect accessed... I can't give you details, not yet. But my team doesn't fully understand what they are. We have engineers from Novomind explaining their own technology to us, and I trust them about as far as I can throw their stock options. He paused, seeming to hear himself. Look, I'm not saying you're involved, but your help in understanding what's at stake here would really help. I need an independent expert who understands these systems and has no financial connection to the company. You need a translator. I need someone who can look at what was accessed and tell me what it actually means. Now what Novomind says it means. What it actually means. Adrian contrittered this. The responsible thing, the safe thing, was to decline. Refer Maro to a colleague. There were dozens of qualified people who could consult on AI systems without the complication of having their name already entangled in the case. The smart play was to smile, offer a list of names, and return to the comfortable business of writing papers about what was wrong with the world, without ever having to touch it. I should tell you, Morrow added, this is voluntary. You're not a suspect, you're not under investigation. I'm asking for your expertise as a consultant. You can say no, and I'll walk out that door and find someone else. Adrian looked again at the photograph on his desk, then moved it aside to make room for Morrow's notepad. He did not yet know what he could offer beyond an interpretation of the evidence, but he could offer that. I'll need to see the case materials, Adrian said. Morrow nodded and something in his posture released. Not dramatically, just a small unbinding of tension, a shift that communicated genuine relief rather than performative gratitude. I'll have them coureered to you. Standard NDA, consultant agreement, the usual. Nothing classified. This is still SFPD jurisdiction. For now. For now is doing a lot of heavy lifting in that sentence.
